source: Version 1 contains the initial live Valley of Trials sweep. Version 2 added a warlock training detour but its trainer entry and endpoint were disproven by live probes. Version 3 confirmed Duokna sales and raised money from 3 to 223 copper, but the Valley trainer approach hit terrain holes. Version 4 established that Nartok's cave floor is below the outdoor terrain layer and is unsupported by current indoor/VMap locomotion. Version 5 routes to Razor Hill warlock trainer Dhugru Gorelust entry 3172 using the quest pack's terrain-v20 candidate corridor; autonomous outbound travel remains unsafe after multiple deaths. Version 6 records controlled live validation after Spirit Healer resurrection: Dhugru has npcFlags 51 at the configured position, lists Corruption 172 for 95 copper, purchase leaves 128 copper, spellbook readback contains 172, and a caster-owned Corruption aura plus Shadow Bolt damage were observed on a Dire Mottled Boar. The Spirit Healer-to-Gar'Thok-to-Dhugru town path is validated; the full autonomous Valley outbound path is not
